signals.why_signal: This adds another Finnish data-centre pipeline of more than 100 MW, with first power planned for 2028, so medium-voltage substation and protection-relay demand would land inside the 18-month component ordering horizon.

evidence.claim: An earlier Yle report says Valorem Energies Finland has only reserved about 32 hectares of land in the Nätki industrial area, and the reservation runs only until the end of 2027. At that point the company had not yet said what the data centre would be used for. This suggests the project is still at an early, non-binding stage, which adds some risk that the 2028 first-phase date slips.
